experience.title: Backend Developer
description: Led backend with Java 20+ and Spring Boot; improved bulk processing by 40%.
Built event-driven flows with Kafka and RabbitMQ; added resilience with Retry and Timeout.
Delivered REST and SOAP APIs; handled 10k+ weekly transactions with Hibernate/JPA.
Automated legal compliance (Res. 2275); cut deployment time by 30% through CI.
Raised coverage to 95% with E2E tests (Playwright) and contract checks (SoapUI).

Designed and developed a dynamic and customizable geolocation microservice based on jerarchies integrating Java and PHP systems using Kafka and RabbitMQ, enabling asynchronous data synchronization and centralized management of location and headquarters configuration.

This initial implementation laid the foundation for an event-driven architecture that later unified microservices into a unique reliable authentication and session management microservice using JWT and refresh tokens.
